description.value: A bakery and coffee shop located on 3rd Street in Ashcroft, a small Thompson River town on the Trans-Canada corridor. The dual-tagged amenity=cafe and shop=bakery in OSM suggests both freshly baked goods and espresso-style coffee service. For touring cyclists riding between Cache Creek and Kamloops, Ashcroft is a logical resupply point with few alternatives.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Facebook website fetch was effectively blocked on all subpages — every URL returned 'You're Temporarily Blocked' with no business content, making the website source unusable. All evidence is therefore limited to OSM tags: amenity=cafe, shop=bakery, building=retail, a phone number, and a 3rd Street address in Ashcroft. No amenity details can be confirmed from any website source.
